mapper.select: SELECT payload FROM fcc_event_inbox WHERE event_id=#{id} AND status='RECOVERING'
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_event_inbox SET status='RECOVERING',recovery_token=#{token},recovery_actor=#{actor}, recovery_attempt_count=recovery_attempt_count+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id=#{id} AND recovery_attempt_count<10 AND (status='UNKNOWN' OR (status='RECOVERING' AND updated_at<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 5 MINUTE))
UPDATE fcc_event_inbox SET status=#{status},last_error=#{error},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id=#{id} AND status='RECOVERING' AND recovery_token=#{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_event_recovery_action(action_id,event_id,actor,status) SELECT #{token},event_id,#{actor},'RUNNING' FROM fcc_event_inbox WHERE event_id=#{id} AND recovery_token=#{token} AND status='RECOVERING'
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_event_recovery_action SET status=#{status},last_error=#{error},finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE action_id=#{token} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO fcc_event_inbox( event_id, node_id, payload, status, attempt_count ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{node}, #{payload}, 'PROCESSING', 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_event_inbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}
UPDATE fcc_event_inbox SET status = #{status}, last_error = #{error}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id = #{id}
